title: Backgammon
tagline: Race your checkers home, and hit when it counts.
teaser: The ancient race game: roll the dice, move your checkers around the board and bear them all off first.

manPage.synopsis: backgammon — roll, move checkers, bear off before your opponent.
manPage.description: Alan Char’s backgammon for BSD, which came with its own tutorial program for newcomers.

howToPlay: Roll the dice and move your checkers around the board.
Land on a lone enemy checker to send it back.
Bring all your checkers home and off the board first.
